require "uri"

def email?(value)
  value.is_a?(String) && URI::MailTo::EMAIL_REGEXP.match?(value)
end
reply: Added `email?(value)` to `email.rb`. It uses Ruby’s standard library to check whether a string looks like an email address, not whether the mailbox exists. Verified that it accepts `amy+work@example.com` and rejects `amy at example.com` and `nil`.
